notes: The dataset is associated with "Encoding performance of cortical neurons critically depends on their morphological and neurophysiological properties" by Omer Revah, Fred Wolf, Michael J Gutnick and Andreas Neef The data in "Raw Data.xlsx" allow replication of the following figures and panels of the publication 2G; 3D; 4GF; 6B; S1C; S3BDF All other files constitute a complete copy of the code on https://github.com/Anneef/AnTools as it was used for the computations in the publication.
